frictions.description: Application crashes with heap corruption (exit code 0xc0000374) during shutdown, but this is a pre-existing issue from commit 8222a5d (particle system modernization) and NOT caused by multi-viewport rendering
frictions.resolution: Identified as known pre-existing issue documented in mission AGENTS.md. Multi-viewport functionality works correctly during the 25-frame run. Crash occurs only during particle system cleanup, not during rendering.

summary: Tested 3 assertions: 3 passed, 0 failed, 0 blocked. All multi-viewport rendering assertions passed successfully. Viewport positioning works correctly with ViewportRect structure. Split-screen layouts (Horizontal2, Vertical2) are implemented and working. Four viewport grid (Quad2x2) is fully functional. Integration tests confirm frame graph integration works correctly. Application crash on shutdown is a pre-existing particle system issue, not related to multi-viewport implementation.
